description: §55.1 / §55.10 — the presence validator's OWN failure and inline message: `<nick is given("…")> = not` starts absent, so `is given` fails with `.NotSome` and its Level-1 inline message renders at `<errors of=>`; isValid is false. (The sibling forms/is-given-validator-inline-message exercises only the length message, because a bound text input never holds `not`.)
rationale: §55.1: `is given` — value exists (absence `not` fails), error tag `.NotSome`, bareword-or-inline-override. §55.10 Level 1: a per-field inline override wins over the shipped default. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, validator too, go".
